# LOL梗 (LOL Geng)

> LOL梗 (www.lolgeng.com) collects funny Chinese internet memes, one interactive page per meme. Content is in Chinese.

## Memes

- [疯狂星期四 Crazy Thursday](https://www.lolgeng.com/event): The weekly "Crazy Thursday / V me 50" meme, with a countdown to the next Thursday and animated effects.
